articles.title: Four Pixels, Four Astronauts: The Longest-Distance Photo of Humans Ever?
articles.summary: A West Virginia telescope captured a blurry image of the Artemis II capsule 213,000 miles away. Inside those few pixels: four astronauts orbiting the moon. It may be the farthest photo of humans taken from Earth—and it's a stunning feat of radio tracking.

articles.title: We Tested the First Self-Cleaning Air Purifier—and It's a Pet Owner's Dream
articles.summary: The Dreame FP10 uses a 360-degree self-cleaning roller to banish pet fur and dander without filter maintenance. It's ultra-quiet, cat-friendly (with a perch and optional weighing tray), and removes 99.97% of airborne particles. A game-changer for furry households.

articles.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2 Crushes the Box Office—Is a Trilogy Inevitable?
articles.summary: The sequel opened to $233 million globally and has already grossed $435 million against a $100 million budget. It's outperforming many Marvel films. Disney will likely pursue Part 3, but high cast salaries and franchise fatigue could be hurdles.
